She looks directly at the camera, speaking with a neutral but engaged facial expression. To her right, a professional condenser microphone is visible. In the background, a warm orange neon sign showing the characters "理科" glows against a plain wall. (2) Following a straight cut, the woman continues her speech, her hands gesturing actively in front of her to emphasize her points. White Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. The lighting is soft and consistent, highlighting her face and torso clearly against the blurred studio background. (3) Another jump cut occurs, slightly shifting the camera angle. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 耶魯大學的. [Logo]: 理科. (2) [Subtitle]: 情緒研究專家 Marc Brackett 說. (3) [Subtitle]: 職場上唯一被接受的情緒 看起來好像只有「快樂」. (4) [Subtitle]: 但一個總是報喜不報憂的同事 是有辦法讓你真正可以信任的嗎? (5) [Subtitle]: 我可能不會真心接受 看到風險 但不表達他害怕的領導人. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為對我來說 真正的勇氣是 看到困難了 有點遲疑害怕 但我們還是努力的前進. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以在職場上 可以適當的表達自己的脆弱. (8) [Subtitle]: 更能覺得自己是在一個 共同前進的團體. (9) [Subtitle]: 在職場上 能適當辨認 並且表達自己情緒的人. (10) [Subtitle]: 不只可以減少 誤會衝突的發生 還可以凝聚整個團隊. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有提高心理的安全感. (12) [Subtitle]: 而心理安全感 是高效團隊的關鍵.
